description: Arriving Vessels Gross and Net Tonnage by Type of Vessel and Country of Previous Port is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by National Planning Council. Number of arriving vessels and their gross and net tonnage at Qatar's ports, by vessel type and by country group of the previous port, by year. Tonnage in tons. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher National Planning Council. Its tags are Ports, arriving vessels. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-06-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
